sections.content:
The `outputRef` in `JsonFormatter.tsx` is used correctly but if the component were to grow in complexity with multiple refs, track cleanup explicitly.

sections.title: Issue A: `Home.tsx` — Double `toLowerCase()` on every filter iteration
sections.content:
```tsx
const matchSearch = tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
```

**Problem**: `search.toLowerCase()` is called inside `filter`, recalculated for every tool on every render.

**Fix**: Pre-compute once in `useMemo` (shown in section 2).

sections.title: Issue B: `JsonFormatter.tsx` — `preprocessJson` regex recompilation
sections.content:
```tsx
function preprocessJson(raw: string): string {
  let s = raw
  s = s.replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '')        // regex compiled every call
  s = s.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '') // regex compiled every call
  s = s.replace(/'/g, '"')
  s = s.replace(/([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*:/g, '$1"$2":')
  return s
}
```

**Problem**: These regex patterns are recompiled on every invocation.

**Fix**: Pre-compile as module-level constants:

```tsx
const RE_SINGLE_LINE_COMMENT = /\/\/.*$/gm
const RE_MULTI_LINE_COMMENT = /\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g
const RE_TRAILING_COMMA = /,\s*([}\]])/g
const RE_SINGLE_QUOTE = /'/g
const RE_UNQUOTED_KEY = /([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*:/g

function preprocessJson(raw: string): string {
  return raw
    .replace(RE_SINGLE_LINE_COMMENT, '')
    .replace(RE_MULTI_LINE_COMMENT, '')
    .replace(RE_TRAILING_COMMA, '$1')
    .replace(RE_SINGLE_QUOTE, '"')
    .replace(RE_UNQUOTED_KEY, '$1"$2":')
}
```

---

sections.title: Priority Summary
sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | Effort |
|-------|--------|--------|
| `JsonFormatter` regex pre-compilation | CPU on every parse | Low |
| `Home` `useMemo` for filtered list | Render optimization | Low |
| `JsonFormatter` setTimeout cleanup | Memory leak | Low |
| `Base64` result caching | Network savings | Medium |
| HTTP response caching in `Home` | Network savings | Medium |
